title: watch: jmap_post does not handle chunked Transfer-Encoding in response body
description: jmap_post (watch.rs:491) reads the HTTP response body by either reading Content-Length bytes or reading until EOF (for no Content-Length). If kithd uses chunked Transfer-Encoding (axum does by default for dynamic responses), neither path decodes chunk framing: the body buffer will contain raw chunk-size lines interleaved with data, causing serde_json::from_slice to fail with a parse error and every JMAP call to silently fail. Fix: send HTTP/1.0 in the request to force non-chunked response, or implement proper chunked TE decoding.
notes: VERIFICATION: kithd JMAP handler builds Body::from(String) which gives a fixed-length body. hyper HTTP/1.1 sets Content-Length for fixed-length bodies and does NOT use chunked TE. This issue may be moot for the JMAP POST path. HOWEVER: the concern is still valid if kithd ever returns a dynamic/streaming JMAP response body, or if the HTTP library changes. The watch.rs code should be explicit about its assumptions. Downgrade to P1 risk rather than P0 bug pending confirmation.
